title: Make it yours
device: Preferences for this device. Create or restore your workspace next.
experienceHint: A few preferences you can change at any time.
securityHint: We recommend; you decide. Changes apply only after saving.
confirmHint: Save, then create or restore a workspace.
startupHint: A lightweight transition, starting on the next launch.
unlockHint: Disabling animation does not change verification.
motionHint: Skipped when your system prefers reduced motion.
autostartHint: Starts the app without automatically unlocking it.
captureHint: Reduce capture of app content. Screenshots, screen sharing and remote assistance may not show the window.
captureLimit: Results depend on the OS and capture tool. External photography cannot be prevented.
macLimit: Capture restrictions depend on the macOS version and cannot block every screenshot or recorder.
overlayHint: Hide content in background previews. iOS cannot block screenshots; screenshot notifications are provided.
unsupported: This system does not support reliable app-level capture exclusion. Use automatic locking and masking instead.
captureOffOff: Currently off · stays off after saving
captureOnOn: Currently on · stays on after saving
idleHint: Balance convenience with protection while away.
idleWarning: Inactivity will not lock the vault. Lock manually when leaving or keep lock-on-sleep enabled.
sleep: Lock on screen lock or sleep
clipboard: Clear copied secrets from the clipboard
clipboardHint: Does not overwrite newer copied content or erase copies held by other apps.
moreSecurity: More privacy options: verification, masking and clipboard detection
reveal: Verification validity for viewing / editing secrets
revealHint: Avoid repeated prompts during this interval. This is separate from startup grace.
mask: Mask the middle of account names
watch: Detect repository links on the clipboard
watchHint: Only observes clipboard repository links when enabled.
laterBio: Set up biometrics after your workspace is ready. Startup grace stays unchanged and is off on new devices.
confirmNotice: Privacy settings apply after saving. Startup animation begins next launch. No vault is created here.
readFailed: Unable to read device preferences. Please retry.
configDamaged: Device configuration could not be read. The original file is preserved. Restore it before retrying; no empty configuration or workspace will be created.
newVersion: This configuration requires a newer app version.
unknown: The save result is unknown. Read the current status before submitting again.
pending: Saving is incomplete; some preferences may already apply. Resume the original operation or read its status first.
uiPending: Device preferences are saved, but interface preferences are incomplete. Finish without repeating OS changes.
reopenHint: Start with current preferences and keep existing choices.
startupSettingHint: Applies next launch and respects reduced motion.
bioHint: Enable local biometrics or system authentication. Keep your recovery key safe; biometrics cannot move to another device.
bioDisclosure: Enabling also permits biometric verification for viewing secrets; change it separately in Settings. Retrieving raw TOTP secrets still requires your access password.
bioPassword: Verify your access password to enable
